scenarios.description: Definition/instance identity and typed properties remain distinct.
Typed link traversal and cardinality are explicit.
ObjectSet composes before explicit materialization and supports aggregation.
Validate-only differs from execution; access, parameter, and domain failures do not collapse.
Named computation is represented separately from action mutation.
Subscriptions and loading/reloading/failure states remain explicit.
Ontology-bound and broader platform clients remain distinct facades.
Application bridge carries explicit async values and configured event execution.
